title: Enter a working project
storyboard: The student opens Ada and reaches Endless Museum on desktop, with the prepared XR route available when a headset is used. They learn where to edit, save, run and return to a hall, and see what the supplied player, camera and lighting contribute to a usable image and body. The hello-world threshold is that their change can appear in a running project; the exact small check still needs choosing. Installing tools and deploying to the headset belong here, before the hall lessons. The student leaves with a working environment and an honest account of what has been prepared for them.
storyboard_short: Open Endless Museum on desktop; prepare XR deployment if used. Teach edit/save/run/return. Explain supplied player, camera and lighting. Verify a saved change appears. Carry: working environment. Open: choose the small hello-world check. Complete setup before hall lessons.
